## Navigation Controls:
- `"home"` - Press home button
- `"back"` - Press back button  
- `"recent"` or `"recents"` - Open recent apps
- `"menu"` - Press menu button

## Device Controls:
- `"power"` - Press power button
- `"unlock"` - Wake device and basic swipe unlock
- `"lock"` - Lock the device
- `"screenshot"` - Take a screenshot with timestamp

## Audio Controls:
- `"volume_up"` - Increase volume
- `"volume_down"` - Decrease volume
- `"mute"` - Toggle mute

## Connectivity Controls:
- `"wifi_on"` / `"wifi_off"` - Enable/disable WiFi
- `"data_on"` / `"data_off"` - Enable/disable mobile data
- `"airplane_on"` / `"airplane_off"` - Enable/disable airplane mode

## Display Controls:
- `"brightness_max"` / `"brightness_min"` - Set brightness levels
- `"rotation_on"` / `"rotation_off"` - Enable/disable auto rotation

## System UI Controls:
- `"notification_panel"` - Pull down notification panel
- `"quick_settings"` - Pull down quick settings panel
- `"close_panels"` - Close system panels

## Advanced:
- `"reboot"` - Reboot the device (with warning)

## Usage Examples:
```python
And("home")           # Go to home screen
And("back")           # Press back button
And("screenshot")     # Take a screenshot
And("wifi_on")        # Enable WiFi
And("brightness_max") # Set brightness to max
```

The function includes:
- **Error handling** for invalid commands and ADB failures
- **Informative logging** for each action
- **Input validation** to ensure `fx` is a string
- **Case-insensitive** command matching
- **Help message** when an unknown command is used

This gives you powerful system-level control over the Android device through simple string commands!
